title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids in Sickle Cell Disease

sections.abstract: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety of a new formulation of the omega-3 fatty acids Docosahexaenoic Acid (DHA) and Eicosapentaenoic Acid (EPA) and to assess whether it decreases inflammation and inflammatory pain in children and young adults with Sickle Cell Disease.
